{"consolidated_memory":"## Memory blowup in graph/store/adjacency.rs — Two separate incidents

**Component:** graph/store/adjacency.rs (graph engine side)

Both incidents involved resident memory climbing with every batch in the adjacency store, reproducible by loading the dense neighbourhood fixture.

### First occasion: 2026-03-04 — Connection pool exhaustion

**Trigger:** Traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
**Root cause:** Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
**Fix:** Raised the pool ceiling and implemented a bounded wait queue in front of it
**PR:** #2296 on branch fix/memory-blowup-1
**Outcome:** Job completed in 28 minutes instead of 5 hours

### Second occasion: 2026-05-27 — N+1 query with lazy relation

**Trigger:** Records carrying non-ASCII names
**Root cause:** N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
**Fix:** Prefetched the relation in a single query
**PR:** #6128 on branch fix/memory-blowup-2
**Stack:** Rust
**Covering check:** Module test block in graph/store/adjacency.rs
**Outcome:** Cold start dropped 96 percent to 727 ms

**Context:** Both incidents occurred in the same area of graph/store/adjacency.rs, carrying over context from earlier memory blowup work."}
